name: Leon
description: Runs an open-source personal AI assistant on your own machine that uses tools, layered memory and computer use to finish tasks with local or remote models.

skills.name: Smart, Controlled and Agent Modes
skills.description: Handles each goal in smart, controlled or agent mode, following deterministic native skills or planning step by step.

skills.name: Computer Use
skills.description: Operates desktop and browser interfaces through progressively loaded computer use and verifies visual outcomes, locally or via Satellite.

skills.name: Layered Memory
skills.description: Remembers durable preferences, day-to-day context and recent discussion in layered memory so answers stay grounded.

skills.name: Native and Agent Skills
skills.description: Runs SKILL.md-backed agent skills alongside native skills built from actions, tools and functions for controlled tasks.

skills.name: Local or Remote Models
skills.description: Switches between local and remote AI providers to balance privacy, control and capability for each task.
